title: Intake Brief
description: One version of a topic's Intake Brief (flow S1). Its content_hash is SHA-256 over the JCS serialization of this document minus content_hash (jcs-rfc8785/1). Confirmation is not a document field: the operator's brief_confirmation decision names this exact topic, brief id, version and hash, and the store records it on the row. A change to any slot is a new version whose parent_version is the one it revises.

objective_in_operator_words.description: The operator's stated ask, verbatim (S1: the brief is the reference the facet audit checks against).

feeds.description: The decision or build the research feeds.
